base: Use case: stylized-concept. Paint an excellent production concept approval sheet for a cozy anime browser RPG, Genshin-like craftsmanship with readable chunky forms, tasteful painterly gouache and crisp edges. Landscape 1600x1000 approx. Warm ivory parchment #ece5d8, navy ink headings, fine gold dividing rules; restrained layout, no decorative clutter. Light top left. Material palette iron blue grey, russet copper, aged yellow brass, dark heartwood, warm ivory tusk, moss green, ochre cloth. Teal ONLY for magic. Hero is the SAME throughout: young chibi adventurer with tousled chestnut brown hair, large amber eyes, ochre short shoulder cape, cream tunic, dark brown trousers and boots, large head small feet. Keep gender neutral, no hats. Big clear object silhouettes, designed to survive 32px. Header and four numbered columns; exact labels, minimal notes. These are reference concepts, not final game sprites. Include small genuinely pixel-style held hero studies at bottom, each in a 128x128 outlined frame, with distinct hand grip and object clearly outside torso. Include small reverse or side details, named material swatches. No photorealism, no excessive filigree, no gore.

sheets.sword: SWORD. Four large full swords side by side, blade pointing up, same size class one-handed short sword. 01 GUILD ISSUE: broad straight blue-grey iron blade, simple dark crossguard, tan wrap. 02 COPPER-BOUND: visible broad copper edge inset along steel blade, copper collar and shed-pelt grip, slight leaf silhouette. 03 BRASS-FITTED: stout steel blade, old brass guard with visible protected coil spring cartridge inside the hilt, sophisticated but handmade. 04 TUSK AND ROOT: warm ivory tusk-tip cutting face spliced to dark heartwood spine, root-shaped guard, vine rope grip, no killed-animal trophy. Strong cumulative improvement in craftsmanship and silhouette without huge size. Beneath each sword show matching hero holding it one-handed at sprite scale; side-view hilt construction detail. Caption materials: Iron / Copper + shed pelt / Gear spring + old brass / Shed tusk + vine rope + heartwood. No glow or magical steel for tier1.
sheets.bow: BOW. Four large bows side by side; matching loose arrow alongside EACH makes arrowhead progression clear. 01 GUILD ISSUE: simple dark wood short bow, linen string, iron arrowhead. 02 COPPER-BOUND: wooden bow with modest copper grip braces, SHED PELT grip, prominent copper-tipped arrow is main upgrade, not an all-copper bow. 03 BRASS-FITTED: spring bow of wood limbs with protected brass coil spring at limb roots, old brass fittings, metal arrowhead. 04 TUSK AND ROOT: heartwood limbs, ivory shed tusk tips at limb ends, braided vine rope string, ivory arrowhead. Keep working string taut and limb mechanics plausible. Beneath EACH bow matching brown-haired ochre-caped chibi hero drawing it SIDE ON facing right, bow clear of chest, true pixel-style study within 128px square. One small reverse grip detail. Exact labels 01 Guild issue, 02 Copper-bound, 03 Brass-fitted, 04 Tusk and root. Material captions identify iron, copper + shed pelt, gear springs + old brass, shed tusk + vine rope + heartwood.
sheets.staff: STAFF. Four large staffs side by side, all hand-length-to-head-height usable walking/battle staffs. 01 GUILD ISSUE: straight ash wood shaft with simple iron ferrule and carved flattened round head, very restrained small teal magic core. 02 COPPER-BOUND: copper-SHOD staff, copper shoe visibly protects bottom, copper collar, shed pelt hand wrap, round head now split petal embracing small teal core. 03 BRASS-FITTED: BRASS-CAPPED staff, old brass crown in open lantern-like cage with protected gear spring band, small teal core. 04 TUSK AND ROOT: living-looking dark HEARTWOOD staff with root fork crown, ivory shed tusk tip inset, vine rope wrap, same small teal core. Clearly increasingly refined silhouettes: round / split / cage / root fork. Head never huge. Beneath each show same hero holding matching staff in hand at native sprite-study scale, feet aligned, some front some side, all coherent identities. Include ferrule reverse-view detail and material names. No sci-fi gun, no blue crystals everywhere.
sheets.armour: ARMOUR. Four columns each shows same brown-haired ochre cape hero full front THREE QUARTER view at large concept scale, then SAME coat BACK VIEW, then 128px pixel-style hero study below. Face hairstyle cape belt boots consistent; coat change apparent. 01 CANVAS JACKET: warm cream canvas with small ochre cape, brown belt, patched elbows, light silhouette. 02 PADDED JACKET: shed-pelt lined quilted canvas, rust copper toggles, thick cream collar, more rounded shoulder. 03 QUILL COAT: dark moss cloth reinforced with neat SHED QUILL panels on shoulder and forearm, short staggered ivory quills laid flat, old brass buckles, flexible human-friendly work coat not spiky villain armour. 04 ROOT-WEAVE: heartwood lamella ribs woven into vine-rope textile, branching chest pattern, small warm ivory shed-tusk clasps, leaf-shaped coat hem, still cozy mobile and visibly strongest. No steel full plate helmets or fur skins with animal heads, everything from calmed creatures or fallen oak. Keep front/cape design from concealing the tier changes. Clearly named swatches canvas, shed pelt, quills, vine rope, heartwood.
sheets.fittings: FITTINGS. Six cells in TWO rows of THREE, each has ONE large detailed fitting SHOWN ATTACHED TO A WEAPON and small detached component inset, plus tiny matching held-hero study. Exact six headings with tier numbers. '02 Quill edge': three short shed-quill barbs locked along copper sword edge, guard breaker. '02 Padded grip': moss-fiber cushion wrap visibly on bow grip, longer dodge. '03 Spring hilt': protected compressible coil spring cartridge INSIDE sword hilt below guard, charge and release heavy strike. '03 Glow cap': lanternfly glow dust in small teal lantern cap attached to STAFF crown, marks target with light. '04 Slick sheath': dark waxed sword scabbard with frog-slick reservoir and small drip spout at foot, dodge leaves slick. '04 Honey binding': amber wax-and-honey sealed braided wrap attached to staff grip, quicker stamina return. Do NOT draw quill strip trap instead of quill edge. These are six optional fittings, pairs are choices at each step, not six tiers. Minimal clear short effect captions, visible materials not abstract power effects.
sheets.tools: FIELD TOOLS. Five equally spaced columns. EXACT order headings 'Axe', 'Hoe', 'Spade', 'Watering can', 'Saw'. Top half beautiful large isolated three-quarter tool portraits; bottom half each tool held correctly by SAME brown-haired ochre cape chibi hero at 128px sprite-study size, plus a 64px-like inventory preview on navy well per column. Common guild workshop family: dark walnut handles, cream cloth grips, restrained copper collars, blue grey iron working edges. AXE single broad wedge head, generous pale cutting edge, hatchet not battle axe, on hero lifted with correct grip. HOE long straight handle, small flat rectangular iron blade at right angle, held with two hands working soil. SPADE long shaft D-handle and rounded pointed shovel blade, two hands. WATERING CAN squat copper belly, big negative-space arch handle, long slanted spout and broad perforated rose, tilted in hero hand pouring water. SAW hand saw, broad tapered blue-grey toothed blade and closed walnut D grip, held clear of torso. Every silhouette unmistakable. Small reverse edge and grip details, named swatches. No pickaxe replacing hoe; no machine saw replacing hand saw.

icons: Use case: stylized-concept. Generate a precise master inventory icon ATLAS for cozy anime RPG. Reference images show approved-for-review sword, bow, staff and armour designs; match their material language exactly. NO TEXT ANYWHERE, no headings, no borders, no shadows, no ornamental background. Image exactly 1600 x 1200, UNIFORM solid warm cream background #ece5d8. Exactly 6 equal width columns and 5 equal height rows of centered separated item illustrations, each wholly inside its cell with generous 20% margins, no overlapping cells, no alternate miniatures. Thirty cells. Read order left to right top to bottom. ROW1: guild iron sword; copper-edged sword with pelt grip; brass spring-hilt sword; ivory tusk-heartwood sword vine wrap; simple wood guild bow iron arrow; copper-braced wood bow copper-tipped arrow. ROW2: brass spring bow; tusk-tipped heartwood bow vine string; iron-shod wood guild staff carved round teal core head; copper-shod split-petal staff; brass lantern cage capped staff; heartwood root fork ivory inset staff. ROW3: canvas jacket alone NO HUMAN; pelt-lined padded jacket alone; green quill coat alone; heartwood vine root-weave coat alone; quill edge sword fitting, three quills on small copper blade-edge clamp; moss-fiber padded grip wrap fitting. ROW4: protected spring hilt fitting; small teal glow dust lantern cap fitting; frog-slick dark leather sheath with drip spout fitting; wax-and-honey amber binding wrap fitting; broad single headed guild woodcutting axe; long handle hoe right-angle flat blade. ROW5: D-handle spade shovel; squat copper watering can long spout and broad rose; hand saw tapered toothed steel blade and closed walnut D-handle; EMPTY; EMPTY; EMPTY. Paint beautiful clean isolated ICONS, thick dark tinted outline, warm top-left light, simplify to major material blocks for 32pixel readability, no microscopic details. Guild tools walnut+cream cloth+iron+copper collars. Do not replace hoe with pickaxe. Exact 27 objects, last3 empty. This master is going to be cropped automatically in a regular grid, so STRICT GRID with cells centered at x=133,400,667,933,1200,1467 and y=120,360,600,840,1080. Keep every object at least 30px away from cell boundaries.
